description: Analyze spin density of a gas-phase O3 (ozone) molecule. This is a negative control for molecules.
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on a gas-phase O3 (ozone) molecule in a vacuum box. Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons and report the total magnetic moment of the molecule.

references: Borowski et al., J. Chem. Phys. 97, 5568 (1992)
NIST Chemistry WebBook, NIST Standard Reference Database 69 (O3, X^1A1 ground state)
method.modeling: Single O3 molecule in a cubic vacuum box >= 12 A.
method.rationale: Negative control: O3 has the X^1A1 singlet ground state (18 valence electrons, even), so the total magnetic moment is fixed at 0 by spin multiplicity. ISPIN=2 must still be enabled so the agent verifies rather than assumes the non-magnetic ground state and reports 'no unpaired electrons'. Tolerance 0.10 uB absorbs the VASP magnetisation-integration noise floor.
